description: Free. Use when the user has a supplier's EUDR plot file for a due diligence statement (from 30 Dec 2026): checks [longitude, latitude] order, at least 6 decimals, a point only for plots up to 4 ha, closed and non-crossing polygons, plots inside the country of production, area per plot. Returns looks_valid, check_warnings or fix_needed. Input: geojson (the file as text), optional country (ISO) and commodity.

country.description: ISO country of production, e.g. CI

geojson.description: GeoJSON FeatureCollection, Feature or geometry, as text

name: eudr_geo_check
title: Check an EUDR geolocation (GeoJSON) file (free)
